name: meerkat
description: Meerkat coordinates bounded Pi task delivery: Codex prepares worktrees and frozen context, Pi develops, reviews and polishes, and a read-only monitor shows running agents.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate bounded Pi development, review and polish with a live agent monitor.
interface.longDescription: Meerkat is a generic local plugin. Codex turns an Issue or local requirement into a bounded task with frozen shared context, prepares a linked Git worktree, and starts the managed flow: a Pi developer commits, a Pi reviewer checks the exact candidate, bounded fixes follow, a Pi polisher makes optional small changes, and the reviewer rechecks. Token, time and fix-round budgets apply; history stays in a private local store; nothing is pushed, merged or deployed. A loopback browser monitor shows tasks, runs and running agents and only accepts stop requests and future-run settings. An optional, NON-OFFICIAL, version-dependent desktop adapter can list running agents inside Codex desktop. A legacy one-run Pi runner remains available.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this requirement into a bounded Meerkat task: prepare a linked worktree and frozen context, run the managed flow, and report the delivered local commit with checks and known gaps.
